title: Austin's Cable TV Franchise, Lawsuit, & Pond Project
summary:
*   A special meeting was held for confidential executive discussions on city matters.
*   Discussions included potential land acquisition for the Alpine Detention Pond Project.
*   The city addressed the settlement of a lawsuit and a proposed franchise transfer involving Austin Cablevision.
*   No final decisions or public actions were taken during this special session.
